name: Salesforce
api_surface: Broad (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, Bulk, Pub/Sub gRPC)
description: A leading cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) platform.
self_serve_details: Free Developer Edition available with full API access.

name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is a CRM platform offering tools for marketing, sales, customer service, and content management with a robust REST API.
self_serve_details: Free developer accounts and sandbox environments are available to create private apps and OAuth credentials.

name: Pipedrive
description: A web-based Sales CRM and pipeline management software designed to help businesses plan sales activities and monitor deals.
self_serve_details: Free developer sandbox accounts are available for testing, and personal API tokens can be generated directly from any standard Pipedrive account settings.

name: Attio
description: Attio is a highly customizable CRM platform designed for modern teams to manage relationships, pipelines, and workflows.
self_serve_details: Attio offers a Free plan that includes API access, allowing developers to sign up and generate API keys immediately.

name: Twenty
description: Twenty is an open-source CRM platform designed as a modern alternative to Salesforce.
self_serve_details: Can be self-hosted for free or accessed via their cloud-hosted version with self-serve API key generation.

name: Podio
description: Podio is a customizable work management and CRM platform that helps teams collaborate and manage projects, tasks, and customer relationships.
self_serve_details: Free tier available; API keys (Client ID and Client Secret) can be generated instantly from the account settings.

name: Zoho CRM
description: Zoho CRM is a cloud-based customer relationship management platform that helps businesses manage sales, marketing, and support in one place.
self_serve_details: Free trial and developer accounts are available. Developers can register clients and obtain OAuth2 credentials via the Zoho Developer Console.

name: Close
description: Close is a sales CRM built for teams that sell, combining calling, email, SMS, pipeline management, and reporting.
self_serve_details: 14-day free trial available with immediate access to API keys from the settings panel.

name: Copper
description: Copper is a CRM designed specifically for Google Workspace users to manage contacts, deals, and pipelines.
self_serve_details: Free trial available; API keys can be generated directly from the settings panel under Integrations.

name: DealCloud
description: DealCloud is a CRM and deal management platform designed specifically for investment banking, private equity, and financial services firms.
self_serve_details: Requires an active DealCloud enterprise subscription. API access must be enabled by an administrator to obtain OAuth2 client credentials.

name: Zendesk
api_surface: Broad REST API covering Support, Help Center, Chat, Talk, and Channels.
description: A customer service platform that provides support ticketing, knowledge base, and customer engagement tools.
self_serve_details: Developers can sign up for a free sponsored Zendesk Developer Support account to access APIs and build integrations.

name: Intercom
description: An AI-first customer service platform providing helpdesk, AI agent, and proactive support tools.
self_serve_details: Free developer workspace can be created instantly to build and test integrations.

name: Freshdesk
description: An AI-powered customer service platform that helps businesses streamline customer support and manage tickets.
self_serve_details: Free 14-day trial available with immediate access to API keys via the user profile settings.

name: Front
description: Front is a customer operations platform that centralizes emails, chats, and SMS into collaborative inboxes with robust API support.
self_serve_details: Developers can sign up for a free developer sandbox account to build and test integrations.

name: Pylon
description: Pylon is a customer support platform designed for B2B companies, integrating support channels like Slack, Microsoft Teams, and email.

name: LiveAgent
description: LiveAgent is a customer support and helpdesk platform featuring live chat, ticketing, and call center capabilities.
self_serve_details: Free trial available with immediate access to API key generation in the admin panel.

name: Plain

name: Aircall

name: Vonage
description: Vonage provides APIs for SMS, voice, video, and multi-channel messaging to integrate communications into applications.

name: Help Scout

name: Gorgias
description: Gorgias is an e-commerce customer support platform that unifies help desk tickets, live chat, and customer data.
self_serve_details: Free trial available; API keys can be generated directly in account settings under REST API.

name: Slack
description: Slack is a popular business communication platform offering a comprehensive API for messaging, bot integration, and workflow automation.

name: Twilio
description: Cloud communications platform for building SMS, voice, and messaging applications.

name: Zoho Cliq

description: Team collaboration and instant messaging platform with APIs for bots, commands, and chat operations.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
description: Enterprise collaboration suite providing APIs for messaging, calendar, drive, tasks, and bot integration.

name: Pumble

name: Discord

name: WhatsApp Business

name: Meta Ads
description: Meta Marketing API enables developers to programmatically manage Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns, ad sets, and creative assets.

name: LinkedIn Ads
description: LinkedIn Ads API allows developers to programmatically manage ad campaigns, target audiences, and retrieve analytics.

name: Mailchimp

name: Pinterest

name: SendGrid

name: WooCommerce
description: An open-source e-commerce plugin for WordPress that provides a comprehensive REST API for managing products, orders, and customers.

name: BigCommerce
api_surface: REST API with a broad set of endpoints covering catalog, customers, orders, analytics, and storefronts.

name: Squarespace

name: Ecwid
api_surface: REST API, broad coverage of stores, products, orders, and customers.

name: Gumroad

name: fanbasis
